name: Celestial Mind and Greater Celestial Mind do not stack on the same target (#5167)
contract: spell_group 1140 (rev_20260928_60) pairs Celestial Mind's first rank 300255 with Greater Celestial Mind 680301 under SPELL_GROUP_STACK_RULE_EXCLUSIVE_FROM_SAME_CASTER (2). CheckSpellGroupStackRules normalizes both casts through SpellInfo::GetFirstRankSpell, which walks any Celestial Mind rank's ChainEntry back to 300255 (spell_ranks first_spell_id), so casting Greater Celestial Mind 680301 on a target that already carries Celestial Mind rank 5 (301225) from the same caster must remove the single-target aura, leaving only the Greater one. Before the fix, no spell_group links these spells, so Unit::AddAura's stacking check finds no shared group and both auras coexist. Greater Celestial Mind's EffectImplicitTargetA[0] is TARGET_UNIT_CASTER_AREA_RAID (56, TARGET_CHECK_RAID), so Spell::SelectImplicitAreaTargets ignores the explicit cast target and instead requires Unit::IsInRaidWith(ally) to be true (WorldObjectSpellTargetCheck, Spell.cpp:9243-9251); the scenario groups caster and ally so the area effect actually reaches the ally.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Greater Celestial Mind is TARGET_UNIT_CASTER_AREA_RAID; the ally must be in caster's raid to receive it
Cast Celestial Mind rank 5 on the ally
Clear the GCD before the next cast
Cast Greater Celestial Mind on the same ally
Greater Celestial Mind reaches the ally
Greater Celestial Mind replaces Celestial Mind rank 5 instead of stacking
